article.title: Sustaining the 4 youth by youth HIV prevention intervention in Nigeria: a cluster randomized controlled trial protocol.
article.authors: Iwelunmor J, Arinze C, Okwuzu J
article.abstract: Sustaining evidence-based HIV prevention interventions remains a challenge, particularly among at-risk youth in Africa. The 4 Youth by Youth (4YBY) sustainment study is a hybrid type 2 cluster randomized controlled trial that evaluates the sustainability and cost-effectiveness of a crowdsourced approach to sustaining a package of evidence-based HIV prevention services. The study will be conducted across 40 community sites, supported by 18 community-based organizations (CBOs) providing HIV prevention services in Nigeria. Given their longstanding engagement with young people, CBOs serve as key partners in assessing long-term sustainability strategies for the 4YBY intervention, which has proven effective in increasing HIV prevention service uptake among youth.
